verified_facts.text: The resort is in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens.
verified_facts.excerpt: One&Only Aesthesis is located in the coastal neighbourhood of Glyfada, in southern Athens

verified_facts.text: The resort recalls the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera.
verified_facts.excerpt: One&Only Aesthesis recalls the 1960s heyday of the Athenian Riviera

verified_facts.text: Architectural firms AUDO, A6Architects and K-Studio, with interior design studio Muza Lab, created the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Three acclaimed architectural firms – AUDO, A6Architects, and K-Studio – along with interior design studio Muza Lab, brought One&Only Aesthesis to life

verified_facts.text: The design stays true to the essence of the Asteria beach club from the 1950s.
verified_facts.excerpt: staying true to the essence of the iconic Asteria beach club from the 1950s

verified_facts.text: The resort offers transfers in luxury vehicles from Athens International Airport, Piraeus Port and central Athens, each a 30-minute drive away.
verified_facts.excerpt: We provide convenient transfers in luxury vehicles from Athens International Airport, Piraeus Port and the centre of Athens, all 30 minutes' drive from the resort.

verified_facts.text: The resort is pet-friendly and caters to dogs.
verified_facts.excerpt: our pet-friendly resort, where your canine companion will be completely catered to

verified_facts.text: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Complimentary high-speed WiFi is available throughout the resort.

verified_facts.text: The boat trip from the sister resort on Kea Island takes 45 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: The boat trip from One&Only Kéa Island takes 45 minutes.

verified_facts.text: Winters on the Athenian Riviera are mild, and sea swimming is still possible in early to mid October.
verified_facts.excerpt: Winters on the Athenian Riviera are refreshingly mild; thanks to warm temperatures, you can still swim in the sea in early–mid October.

verified_facts.text: In the 1950s and '60s the Asteria beach was a playground for socialites and starlets.
verified_facts.excerpt: Asteria—meaning ‘stars’ in Greek—was a playground for socialites and starlets

verified_facts.text: Many classic black-and-white Greek movies were shot in the original Asteria Modernist bungalows and open-air restaurant.
verified_facts.excerpt: many classic black-and-white Greek movies were shot in the Modernist bungalows and open-air restaurant

verified_facts.text: Bungalows are dotted around the grounds; some are right on the sea, others surrounded by rosemary, bougainvillea and olive trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some are right on the sea, others enveloped in rosemary, bougainvillea, and olive trees.

verified_facts.text: Bungalow outdoor areas have a private pool, loungers, an outdoor shower and a fireplace.
verified_facts.excerpt: It’s the alfresco areas—private pool, plentiful loungers, outdoor shower, and fireplace—that really elevate the spaces.

verified_facts.text: The spa is a Guerlain spa, with treatments featuring Guerlain's signature scents.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments feature Guerlain’s signature scents

verified_facts.text: The spa has a Glamour Studio for simultaneous hair, make-up and nail rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Glamour Studio for simultaneous hair, make-up, and nail rituals

verified_facts.text: Connected to the spa are a Technogym fitness centre, a yoga pavilion and an outdoor lap pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Connected to the spa is a Technogym fitness centre, yoga pavilion, and an outdoor lap pool

verified_facts.text: Every guest has two dedicated hosts, on call around the clock via WhatsApp.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every guest has two dedicated hosts, on-call round-the-clock (via What’s App)

verified_facts.text: At Ora restaurant most dishes are wood-fired or cooked on the parilla grill.
verified_facts.excerpt: most dishes are wood-fired or cooked on the parilla grill

verified_facts.text: El Bar, next to the main building, serves tapas from chef Paco Morales.
verified_facts.excerpt: Next to the main building, El Bar offers a dazzlingly original take on tapas from Paco Morales

verified_facts.text: The resort has padel and tennis courts and non-motorized watersports, including stand-up paddle board and windsurfing lessons.
verified_facts.excerpt: There are Padel and tennis courts and non-motorized watersports, including stand-up paddle board or windsurfing lessons

verified_facts.text: Private museum tours, sandal-making workshops and boat trips to the nearby islands of Aegina and Kea can be arranged.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private museum tours, sandal-making workshops, and boat trips to the nearby islands of Aegina and Kea

verified_facts.text: The buildings have LEED and SITES certification.
verified_facts.excerpt: The buildings have LEED and SITES certification

verified_facts.text: A protected forest within the resort's boundaries remains untouched.
verified_facts.excerpt: A protected forest within the boundaries of the resort remains untouched.

verified_facts.text: The resort is separated from Glyfada's shops and restaurants by six-lane Poseidonos Avenue, with heavy traffic.
verified_facts.excerpt: The resort is separated from the neighborhood’s upscale boutiques and fast-food restaurants by six-lane Poseidonos Avenue, with thundering traffic around the clock.

verified_facts.text: The resort sits on a gated peninsula.
verified_facts.excerpt: The gated peninsula is a bubble of extreme attentiveness

verified_facts.text: Bungalows, villas and residences are scattered between lush gardens and the shoreline, following the original site layout.
verified_facts.excerpt: bungalows, villas and residences are scattered between lush gardens and the shoreline
